turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Definitely. I'm hoping to hit the climbing gym here in Austin tomorrow evening to burn off some of this work week's stress.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a solid plan. Climbing is always a great stress-reliever. Best of luck with the rest of your meetings today, Leo!

turns.speaker: user
